subject: The 10,000 user shocker
preview_text: We analyzed 10,000 users and found something shocking. The best predictors share one simple habit.
body_paragraphs: Here's the thing. We crunched the numbers from 10,000 Predictify users over the last 63 days, and one pattern jumped out like a red card at a derby. The ones who hit 70%+ on their predictions didn't just rely on gut. They did one thing before every match.

It's not about more data. It's about the right data at the right time. These users checked the AI's confidence score for the match, then cross-referenced it with the head-to-head stats. That combo alone boosted their accuracy by 23%. No tipster, no insider info. Just the app.

Here's the feature that separates the pros from the punters: the pre-match insights card. It loads in 3 seconds and shows you the AI's top 3 variables for the upcoming game — like xG differential or defensive gaps from the last 5 matches. Open Predictify now, tap any match, and swipe left to see your edge.
Stop guessing. Start knowing. Open the app and check the confidence score on your next match. P.S. — The top 3 users in the IQ Quiz this week all use this feature. Don't get left behind.
